request.prompt: The interior of a modern London Underground train carriage, seen from a seated passenger's eye level looking across the aisle. A row of seats upholstered in a busy blue, red and teal patterned moquette fabric, yellow-green grab poles, white curved interior panels, small red safety stickers by the doors, dark tunnel blur outside the windows, cool fluorescent ceiling light. The carriage is quiet, with a couple of anonymous commuters out of focus at the far end and the facing seats empty. Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 35mm lens, natural London light, high-end commercial colour grade, fine film grain. One single continuous photograph, not a collage. No readable text, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks.
